model_details.name: InspectAI SpectralFusionCNN
model_details.type: Dual-Branch 1D Waveform & Hilbert Envelope Spectrum Convolutional Neural Network

intended_use.primary_domain: Industrial rolling element bearing condition monitoring and fault classification.
intended_use.operating_context: Deep groove ball bearings (SKF 6205 series) operating under variable motor load (0 to 3 HP, 1,720 to 1,797 RPM).

training_data.dataset_name: Case Western Reserve University (CWRU) Bearing Data Center

ethical_and_operational_limitations.cross_machine_transfer: Validated on CWRU motor-driven test rig only. Domain adaptation or fine-tuning is required before transferring to different bearing geometries or gearboxes.
ethical_and_operational_limitations.early_failure_prediction: The model classifies active mechanical defect signatures; it does not forecast remaining useful life (RUL) or incipient metallurgical fatigue prior to surface spalling.
ethical_and_operational_limitations.unseen_fault_modes: Detects Normal, Ball, Inner Race, and Outer Race faults. Unmodeled failure modes (e.g., cage fracture, severe misalignment, electrical fluting) may yield uncertain predictions.
ethical_and_operational_limitations.uncalibrated_probabilities: Softmax scores represent model class attribution and do not equal empirical Bayesian posterior probabilities.
